title: Police constable stages black-flag protest over alleged medical negligence

tea.why: A police constable protested against alleged medical negligence that led to his 10-year-old daughter's leg amputation.
tea.want: He demanded state government intervention regarding the alleged medical negligence at the government hospital.
tea.changed: Oct 10, 2026: The constable was detained and arrested by local police following his black-flag protest.

summary: A head constable assigned to the Avadi Tank Factory police station conducted a black-flag protest near his residence in Muthapudupet, Chennai, expressing grievances regarding the medical treatment of his 10-year-old daughter at the Institute of Child Health and Hospital for Children in Egmore. According to reports, the protester stated that his daughter suffered from a kidney disorder and accused hospital staff of misdiagnosing a seizure as brain fever in October 2021, leading to complications that resulted in the amputation of her leg. The protest occurred ahead of the Prime Minister's scheduled visit to Chennai. Muthapudupet police detained and arrested the individual following the demonstration. The hospital reportedly denied the allegations of negligence.
demands: State government intervention regarding alleged hospital negligence
response: According to the sources, the hospital denied the allegations of medical negligence, and Muthapudupet police detained and arrested the constable following the protest.

arrests.text: Muthapudupet police detained Kothandapani, near his home in Muthapudupet.
